candidates.name: Observations, Measurements, and Samples Standard
verified_facts: OMS defines a conceptual schema for observations, observation procedures, features of interest and samples.
It supports exchange of observation acts and their results across scientific and technical communities.
semantic_limits: A valid OMS observation record describes measurement context but does not certify sensor calibration, vertical datum, spatial accuracy or parcel-specific terrain validity.

candidates.name: Features and Geometries JSON (JSON-FG) Standard
verified_facts: JSON-FG extends GeoJSON to support additional coordinate reference systems, temporal characteristics and richer geometry capabilities.
Valid JSON-FG remains compatible with GeoJSON rules for supported content.
semantic_limits: Encoding a feature with a non-WGS84 CRS or richer geometry does not establish coordinate precision, exact legal-boundary authority or terrain measurement accuracy.
